description: Source code for Realtek RTL83xx series Ethernet switch driver, implementing switch setup, VLAN management, MAC address handling, port configuration, and PHY link handling within the Linux kernel DSA (Distributed Switch Architecture) framework.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_setup(struct dsa_switch * ds)
methods.description: Initializes and configures the RTL83xx switch, including port setup, VLAN setup, MAC initialization, and PHY polling enabled.

methods.name: int rtl93xx_setup(struct dsa_switch * ds)
methods.description: Configuration routine for RTL930x family switches, including port disablement, VLAN setup, and PHY setup.

methods.name: int dsa_phy_read(struct dsa_switch * ds,int phy_addr,int phy_reg)
methods.description: Reads PHY register via MDIO, with specific handling for certain internal ports.

methods.name: int dsa_phy_write(struct dsa_switch * ds,int phy_addr,int phy_reg,u16 val)
methods.description: Writes PHY register via MDIO, with specific handling for certain internal ports.

methods.name: enum:dsa_tag_protocol rtl83xx_get_tag_protocol(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,enum dsa_tag_protocol mprot)
methods.description: Returns the tagging protocol used by this hardware (DSA trailer protocol).

methods.name: void rtl83xx_phylink_validate(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,unsigned long * supported,struct phylink_link_state * state)
methods.description: Validates supported PHY link modes based on port interface capabilities.

methods.name: void rtl93xx_phylink_validate(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,unsigned long * supported,struct phylink_link_state * state)
methods.description: Validates PHY link modes including advanced modes specific to RTL930x family.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_phylink_mac_link_state(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,struct phylink_link_state * state)
methods.description: Reads the physical link state, speed, duplex, and pause settings from hardware registers.

methods.name: int rtl93xx_phylink_mac_link_state(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,struct phylink_link_state * state)
methods.description: Reads link state for RTL930x including internal SerDes status.

methods.name: void rtl83xx_phylink_mac_config(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,unsigned int mode,const struct phylink_link_state * state)
methods.description: Configures PHY link parameters such as speed, duplex, and interface mode for the switch ports.

methods.name: void rtl931x_phylink_mac_config(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,unsigned int mode,const struct phylink_link_state * state)
methods.description: Specific PHY configuration for RTL931x family, including SerDes init.

methods.name: void rtl93xx_phylink_mac_config(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,unsigned int mode,const struct phylink_link_state * state)
methods.description: Configures PHY interface mode and speed for RTL930x family, including SDS setup.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_port_enable(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,struct phy_device * phydev)
methods.description: Enables a port, including VLAN tagging, traffic enabling, and SDS configuration.

methods.name: void rtl83xx_port_disable(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port)
methods.description: Disables a port, removing its traffic and VLAN configurations.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_vlan_filtering(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,bool vlan_filtering,struct netlink_ext_ack * extack)
methods.description: Enables or disables VLAN filtering on a port.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_vlan_add(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,const struct switchdev_obj_port_vlan * vlan,struct netlink_ext_ack * extack)
methods.description: Adds a VLAN to a port, including tagged/untagged configuration.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_vlan_del(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,const struct switchdev_obj_port_vlan * vlan)
methods.description: Removes VLAN membership from a port.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_port_fdb_add(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,const unsigned char * addr,u16 vid)
methods.description: Adds a unicast MAC address entry to the switch forwarding database.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_port_fdb_del(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,const unsigned char * addr,u16 vid)
methods.description: Removes a unicast MAC address entry from the switch forwarding database.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_port_fdb_dump(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,dsa_fdb_dump_cb_t * cb,void * data)
methods.description: Iterates over MAC entries and reports addresses associated with a port.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_port_mdb_add(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,const struct switchdev_obj_port_mdb * mdb)
methods.description: Adds a multicast group entry for a port.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_port_mdb_del(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,const struct switchdev_obj_port_mdb * mdb)
methods.description: Removes a multicast group entry for a port.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_port_mirror_add(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,struct dsa_mall_mirror_tc_entry * mirror,bool ingress)
methods.description: Adds port mirroring between ingress/egress groups.

methods.name: void rtl83xx_port_mirror_del(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,struct dsa_mall_mirror_tc_entry * mirror)
methods.description: Removes port mirroring configuration.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_port_bridge_join(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,struct net_device * bridge)
methods.description: Handles adding a port to a Linux bridge, updating switch masks accordingly.

methods.name: void rtl83xx_port_bridge_leave(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,struct net_device * bridge)
methods.description: Handles removing a port from a Linux bridge.

methods.name: void rtl83xx_port_stp_state_set(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,u8 state)
methods.description: Configures Spanning Tree Protocol state for a port.

methods.name: void rtl83xx_fast_age(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port)
methods.description: Performs an immediate aging of FDB entries for a port.

methods.name: void rtl931x_fast_age(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port)
methods.description: Fast aging on RTL931x.

methods.name: void rtl930x_fast_age(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port)
methods.description: Fast aging for RTL930x family, including switching to RTL931x method for newer chips.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_vlan_prepare(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,const struct switchdev_obj_port_vlan * vlan)
methods.description: Prepares VLAN configuration before adding/removing ports.

methods.name: rtl83xx_vlan_add
methods.description: Adds a port to a VLAN, adjusting tagged/untagged bitmap.

methods.name: rtl83xx_vlan_del
methods.description: Removes a port from a VLAN.

methods.name: void rtl83xx_setup_l2_uc_entry(struct rtl838x_l2_entry * e,int port,int vid,u64 mac)
methods.description: Initializes an L2 unicast address table entry.

methods.name: void rtl83xx_setup_l2_mc_entry(struct rtl838x_l2_entry * e,int vid,u64 mac,int mc_group)
methods.description: Initializes an L2 multicast address table entry.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_find_l2_hash_entry(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,u64 seed,bool must_exist,struct rtl838x_l2_entry * e)
methods.description: Finds an L2 hash entry in the hash table.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_find_l2_cam_entry(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,u64 seed,bool must_exist,struct rtl838x_l2_entry * e)
methods.description: Finds an L2 CAM spillover entry.

methods.description: Adds a MAC address to the FDB, including hash or CAM placement.

methods.name: rtl83xx_port_fdb_del
methods.description: Removes a MAC address from the FDB.

methods.name: rtl83xx_port_mdb_add
methods.description: Adds a multicast address (MDB entry).

methods.name: rtl83xx_port_mdb_del
methods.description: Removes a multicast address.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_port_lag_join(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,struct net_device * lag,struct netdev_lag_upper_info * info)

methods.name: int rtl83xx_port_lag_leave(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,struct net_device * lag)
methods.description: Handles LAG leave event for ports.
